review_comments: Might be worth adding an assert along the lines of `Enum.GetValues<HttpRequestError>().Length == 12` so we don't forget to add potential new values to this switch in the future.

The unit should be set to "{connection}"

@lmolkova - confirming that is correct and not just some formatting thing in the spec that wasn't intended to be used literally?
This fixes #89451 by making the test deterministic.

I think @JamesNK uses "2" and "3" for HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 for asp.net core and kestrel, which, I believe, matches their RFCs ([HTTP/2](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7540), [HTTP/3](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9114)).

can we still unify?
Yup I will open a follow-up PR.

Do we care about matching the descriptions here with the [updated recommendations](https://github.com/lmolkova/semantic-conventions/blob/dotnet8-metrics/docs/dotnet/dotnet-http-metrics.md#metric-httpclientrequestduration) you mentioned?
I didn't like the "Measures" verb here 😄, trying to fix the doc instead: https://github.com/lmolkova/semantic-conventions/pull/1#pullrequestreview-1559584159
